import sys

    errs.append("FAIL user_wait missing import re")
else:
    print("PASS user_wait import re")

sys.path.insert(0, str(HOME / "broccoli/lib"))
from brocc_validate import brocc_reply_is_junk

    errs.append("FAIL junk should reject chip")
else:
    print("PASS junk rejects chip")
if brocc_reply_is_junk("LOOP_OK\nNEXT_STEP: x"):
    errs.append("FAIL junk should accept LOOP_OK")
else:
    print("PASS junk accepts LOOP_OK")

# 3 worker gate
g = HOME / "broccoli_worker_gate.sh"
if g.exists() and (g.stat().st_mode & 0o111):
    print("PASS worker_gate executable")
else:
    errs.append("FAIL worker_gate")

# 4 daemon shebang
d = HOME / "broccoli-daemon.sh"
if d.exists():
    line1 = d.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines()[0]
    if "bash" in line1:
        print("PASS daemon shebang")
    else:
        errs.append("FAIL daemon shebang: " + line1)
else:
    errs.append("FAIL no daemon.sh")

# 5 report toast safe
r = HOME / "broccoli_report.py"
if r.exists() and "_toast_safe" in r.read_text(errors="replace"):
    print("PASS report toast safe")
else:
    errs.append("FAIL report toast safe")

if errs:
    print("\n".join(errs))
    sys.exit(1)
print("PASS P0 static checks")
